metrics.name: overall_accuracy
metrics.description: Proportion of recall trials in which the first three typed letters match the first three letters of the target word. Random typing has effectively zero chance of matching (1/26^3 per trial). Haridi & Schulz (Memory Festival, MPI Tübingen) report adult human recall accuracies in the 0.55-0.75 range across similarity levels.

metrics.name: accuracy_high_sim
metrics.description: Recall accuracy on highly similar pairs (similarity_level >= 0.8). Easier than low-similarity pairs because semantic association supports retrieval.

metrics.name: accuracy_low_sim
metrics.description: Recall accuracy on dissimilar pairs (similarity_level <= 0.2). Hardest condition.

metrics.name: mean_recall_rt
metrics.description: Mean response time on recall trials (ms from cue onset to submit). Indicates retrieval ease.

metrics.name: timeout_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of recall trials that ended without a submitted response. Should be low for engaged participants.
